CustomField.label: Action URL
CustomField.description: Optional. The URL for the read-only remediation link labeled by "Action Label". Use it for docs, playbooks, or Salesforce deep links; it never updates records automatically. Supports {!FieldName} merge tokens, including relationship paths such as {!Owner.ManagerId}, resolved against the record before the link is shown. Both "Action Label" and "Action URL" must be set for the link to appear.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional. Where the remediation link goes - docs or a Salesforce page, e.g. /lightning/r/Report/00O.../view?fv0={!Id}. Read-only; may use {!FieldName} tokens. Set "Action Label" too.
